messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: GPU pool saturation in eu-west1 (1811000123)

alex.sre: paging oncall - eu-west1 GPU queue exploding, queue depth +120% in 7m. Autoscaler failing to add nodes :rotating_light:

priya.ml: seeing OOM eviction spikes and retries; pods stuck Pending due to GPU zone quota. Errors in control-plane logs: `compute.instances.insert denied: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded`

tom.platform: confirmed create errors from cloud: `compute.instances.insert denied: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded` across region eu-west1. Autoscaler attempted scale at 1811000300 and got 403s.

alex.sre: @julia-night-sre are you available? Need quick decision on spillover.

julia-night-sre: Oncall here. Suggest immediate cross-region spill to eu-central1 + eu-north1, set spill ratio 0.7 and lower per-customer QPS 25% to reduce burst.

leo.platform: applying routing change: `rbctl route set --primary eu-west1 --fallbacks eu-central1,eu-north1 --spill-ratio 0.7` - pushed.

deploy-bot: routing update applied (id: r-7781) :white_check_mark:

priya.ml: initial spike on fallbacks shows model mismatch in eu-north1; some variants not deployed -> 502s. We should fall back to compatible 'v1-safe' variant.

tom.platform: promoting v1-safe in eu-north1: `rbctl model deploy --region eu-north1 --model v1-safe` -> done.

priya.ml: error rate dropped from ~15% to 4% after deploy; p95 latency +200ms.

sara.support: multiple customers opened tickets about timeouts; marking as P2 for enterprise customers. Preparing status note.

infra-pager: reached out to cloud support for emergency GPU quota increase in eu-west1. ETA 30-60m for approval. If denied, consider promoting eu-central1 primary.

alex.sre: temporary mitigation: enabling degraded-mode on Dedicated pools for affected orgs to avoid hard throttles. @sara.support confirm opt-ins.

sara.support: contacting top impacted accounts now; sending interim message with expected window 1-2h.

priya.ml: started KV cache pre-warm in fallbacks for hot prefixes. Running `rbctl cache prewarm --regions eu-central1,eu-north1 --prefix /api/chat`.

deploy-bot: cache prewarm job queued (job: prewarm-9921)

leo.platform: also discovered autoscaler controller crashed due to token rotation bug at 1811000350 — deployed quick-patch `hotfix/scaler-rotate` to control plane.

alex.sre: hotfix rolled; future scale attempts should use refreshed token.

julia-night-sre: current metrics 18m in:
- eu-west1 queue down 40%
- spill traffic ~65% to fallbacks
- 5xx global ~2.1%
- tail latency up +180ms

priya.ml: still seeing ~1% of requests failing due to version-pin from some customers; recommend server-side trick to prefer fallback-compatible variants when rerouting. Opening ticket INF-8601.

infra-pager: cloud granted temporary +16 GPUs for eu-west1, provisioning now (ETA 12m). Will auto-scale once nodes ready.

alex.sre: prepping handoff: summary + open tasks. Handoff to night-sre (maria) at 1811006000.

julia-night-sre: taking over. Handoff checklist:
- monitor quota provisioning (infra-pager)
- maintain routing spill ratio unless error rate increases (leo.platform)
- keep degraded model in fallbacks (priya.ml)
- customer comms updates (sara.support)
- follow-up ticket INF-8601 for version availability

sara.support: sent customer update and created credits offers where SLA impacted.

priya.ml: noted follow-ups: ensure model build pipeline publishes fallback-compatible artifacts to all regions; add autoscaler token rotation unit tests.

leo.platform: created INF-8601 and INF-8602 for follow-ups.

deploy-bot: incident set to monitoring (incident-1811000123)

alex.sre: exporting raw timeline to s3://redwood-incidents/1811000123/timeline.log

julia-night-sre: taking watch, will escalate if quota not provisioned in 60m. Leaving thread open for handoff.

sara.support: closing customer-facing tickets as mitigated pending further issues.

alex.sre: postmortem action items assigned. Good work team.
